purpose: Fix the semantic design of the SOSA and SSN confirmatory extension before source selection or execution.
study_role: Independent confirmatory extension. It is not pooled with the locked Movie and Music preliminary study

ontology.status: W3C and OGC First Public Working Draft. This is a pinned draft snapshot and work in progress. It is not a W3C Recommendation
ontology.historical_2017_role: Background and compatibility reference only. It is not an experimental ontology

base_axiom_conditions.disjointness: pairwise disjoint SOSA collection classes in the pinned SSN graph
base_axiom_conditions.functional_property_conflict: functional sosa:hasResult or sosa:hasSimpleResult in the pinned SOSA graph

application_profile_conditions.domain_range: explicit SHACL subject and object class constraints
application_profile_conditions.cardinality: explicit SHACL required value constraints for the record derived graph pattern
application_profile_conditions.temporal: SHACL SPARQL implementation of the collection member range or interval rule

grounding_condition: controlled assertion unsupported by the source and derived from the fixed source record
forbidden_temporal_generalization: A universal rule that phenomenonTime precedes resultTime is prohibited.

source_strategy.source_text: deterministically rendered from the same fixed public record used to build the clean graph
initial_source_families: official W3C SOSA and SSN examples from the pinned snapshot
fixed historical USGS water observation records
fixed historical US EPA air quality records

sampling.selection_timing: after eligible pool enumeration and before model outcomes
